summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — not to be confused with Pronous among the twelve noblest wooers from Ithaca itself in Epitome 7.30.

story.text: Apollodorus names Pronomus among the Zacynthian wooers, listed after Liocritus and before Nisas in Epitome 7.29.
